title: Bullseye Interview
content: BoingBoing's Mark Frauenfelderdid an interview with Jesse Thorn on the podcast Bullseye. He describes theZeo sleep manager, which gives you a read-out on your past night's sleep (I need one!).And he also recommends GurneyJourney (around the 4:00 mark).Here are the links to the posts he refers to:Macro Photos of the Human EyeBuilding reference models of dinosaursVideo of Sketching a DonkeyPortrait of Jehovah's Witnesses-----Direct link to interviewThanks, Mark -- and Heather for telling me about it.
